keyInsights: There is no final view. There is only the viewing. And the viewing is productive.
The water is not the obstacle. The water is the environment that makes navigation meaningful.
The village sees what no villager sees. We contribute to a vision we cannot individually possess.
Racing assumes a single destination. Paralleling assumes the journey itself is the point.
The shore is not where the crossing ends. The shore is where the crossing becomes collaborative.
